verdict.rationale: A GitHub repository documents a `smithery` CLI with commands to search the registry, add MCP server connections, find tools by intent and call tools, which fits AI-native agentic workflows. However, the repo sits under the arcadeai-labs org and none of the first-party Smithery docs in the pack mention or link to it, so its official status is not established. Missing for 10: first-party docs confirming it as the official CLI, install/auth documentation, depth on agent-oriented features (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: smithery mcp search [term]              # Search the Smithery registry
smithery tool call <connection> <tool> [args]  # Call a tool
Browse skills on the [Smithery Skills Registry](https://smithery.ai/skills) and install them with the upstream installer
